newsitem.title: USA: Rush Enterprises forms new division.
newsitem.headline: Rush Enterprises forms new division.

text.p: Rush Enterprises Inc on Friday said it formed a construction-equipment division called Rush Equipment Centers.

A John Deere construction-equipment dealership covering 20 counties in and around the Houston, Texas, will serve as the division's main asset. The company said it signed a letter of intent to purchase the dealership from C. Jim Stewart.
The acquisition, subject to the approval of John Deere Construction Equipment Co, part of Deere & Co, is expected to close on or about September 30, 1997.
Rush told Reuters that it would disclose terms of the transaction when the deal was finalized.
Rush currently operates heavy-duty truck distribution networks.
